title: Proton MRI of MSK Disorders
official: Ultra-Short Echo Time 1H MRI in Individuals With Thoracic Musculoskeletal Disorders
summary: In this research study, the investigators want to learn about new ways to use MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) to take clearer pictures of the lungs. The investigators will be using types of MRI called UTE (Ultra Short Echo Time) and bSSFP (balanced Steady-State Free Precession) as well as traditional MRI. The investigators also want to collect images and health information about lungs that are healthy or those in people with different kinds of lung, muscular, and bone diseases. This collection will help us in the future to better understand lung variations in health and disease.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 5 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of any comorbidity reviewed at the Screening phone call that, in the opinion of the investigator, might confound the results of the study or pose an additional risk to the subject.
* Standard MRI exclusion criteria as set forth by the CCHMC Radiology Department and IRC.
* Pregnancy
